based_on: Through the 2026-06-15 full run (month-to-date vs the prior equal-length period)
headline: Citation rate is holding at ~15.6% — branded queries are locked in, but competitors still own every "alternative to" comparison query.

items.title: Perplexity, our strongest engine, is cooling
items.detail: Perplexity still cites DonorDock far more than the others (26.2%), but that's down from ~29.4% the prior period. It also drives ~64% of run cost, so a sustained slide there moves the whole number. Worth watching week over week.

items.title: GPT-4o and the cheaper engines are warming up
items.detail: OpenAI's citation rate climbed from 9.4% to 12.0% (+2.6pp); Anthropic and Gemini each ticked up ~1pp. The engines that lagged Perplexity are slowly starting to surface DonorDock.

items.title: Win the comparison queries — they're the biggest blind spot
items.detail: "Alternative to Bloomerang" cited zero DonorDock across all 11 runs; "Cheaper alternative to Blackbaud" and "Best donor management software for nonprofits" are nearly as bad. These are high-intent, bottom-funnel questions competitors fully own. Comparison/alternative pages with strong schema are the highest-leverage content bet.

items.title: Three pillars are effectively invisible to AI engines
items.detail: Donor Retention (0%), Fundraising Strategy (1.7%), and AI for Nonprofits (3.9%) almost never get DonorDock cited. They have content but aren't structured to be quoted. Prioritize FAQ blocks, schema, and pillar-up interlinking on these three.

items.title: Bottom-of-funnel AEO is solid
items.detail: Branded questions — What is DonorDock, pricing, reviews, is it good — are cited across all four engines and early in the answer. When someone already knows the name, the engines describe us well. The work is upper-funnel discovery.

items.title: Bloomerang sets the pace; field is stable
items.detail: Bloomerang is mentioned ~217×/run — roughly 3.5× DonorDock's citation volume — with DonorPerfect and Little Green Light next. Per-run share is roughly flat vs the prior period, so no competitor is making a sudden move; this is a steady gap to close, not a fire.
